type MairiesContextValue = {
  mairies: Mairie[]
  createMairie: (value: NouvelleMairie) => Mairie
  updateMairie: (id: string, patch: Partial<NouvelleMairie>) => void
  archiveMairie: (id: string) => void
  restoreMairie: (id: string) => void
  importMairies: (rows: { value: NouvelleMairie; existingId?: string }[]) => void
}

const MairiesContext = createContext<MairiesContextValue | null>(null)

function createId() {
  return `mairie-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`
}

export function MairiesProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [mairies, setMairies] = useState<Mairie[]>(() => {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY)
      if (!raw) return seedMairies
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw)
      return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : seedMairies
    } catch {
      return seedMairies
    }
  })

  useEffect(() => {
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(mairies))
  }, [mairies])

  const value = useMemo<MairiesContextValue>(() => ({
    mairies,
    createMairie(input) {
      const now = new Date().toISOString()
      const item: Mairie = {
        ...input,
        id: createId(),
        historique: [
          { id: createId(), date: now.slice(0, 10), libelle: 'Fiche mairie créée' },
        ],
        createdAt: now,
        updatedAt: now,
      }
      setMairies((current) => [item, ...current])
      return item
    },
    updateMairie(id, patch) {
      const now = new Date().toISOString()
      setMairies((current) => current.map((item) =>
        item.id === id
          ? {
              ...item,
              ...patch,
              updatedAt: now,
              historique: [
                { id: createId(), date: now.slice(0, 10), libelle: 'Fiche mairie modifiée' },
                ...item.historique,
              ],
            }
          : item,
      ))
    },
    importMairies(rows) {
      const now = new Date().toISOString()
      setMairies(current => {
        const result = [...current]
        for (const row of rows) {
          const index = row.existingId ? result.findIndex(m => m.id === row.existingId) : -1
          if (index >= 0) {
            const previous = result[index]
            result[index] = {
              ...previous, ...row.value,
              // Preserve historical records and attached documents.
              participations: previous.participations,
              documents: previous.documents,
              updatedAt: now,
              historique: [{ id: createId(), date: now.slice(0, 10), libelle: 'Fiche mise à jour par import Excel' }, ...previous.historique],
            }
          } else {
            result.push({ ...row.value, id: createId(), createdAt: now, updatedAt: now,
              historique: [{ id: createId(), date: now.slice(0, 10), libelle: 'Fiche créée par import Excel' }] })
          }
        }
        return result
      })
    },
    archiveMairie(id) {
      setMairies((current) => current.map((item) =>
        item.id === id ? { ...item, statut: 'ARCHIVEE', updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() } : item,
      ))
    },
    restoreMairie(id) {
      setMairies((current) => current.map((item) =>
        item.id === id ? { ...item, statut: 'ACTIVE', updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() } : item,
      ))
    },
  }), [mairies])

  return <MairiesContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</MairiesContext.Provider>
}

export function useMairies() {
  const context = useContext(MairiesContext)
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useMairies doit être utilisé dans MairiesProvider')
  }
  return context
}

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react' import { Printer, X, QrCode } from 'lucide-react' import QRCode from 'qrcode' import './FeuilleStand.css' type StandSheet = { id: string nom: string lieu: string adresseStand?: string date: string debut: string fin: string responsable: string benevoleIds: string[] autresBenevoles: string caissePrevue: boolean tpePrevu: boolean briochesPrevues: number notes: string } type Volunteer = { id: string; nom: string; prenom: string } type Props = { stand: StandSheet benevoles: Volunteer[] caisseLabels: string[] tpeLabels: string[] distributed: number giftCount: number giftTotal: number onClose: () => void } const SUPPORT_PHONE_DISPLAY = '03 83 44 30 65' const SUPPORT_PHONE_LINK = 'tel:+33383443065' const TEAMS_SUPPORT_URL = 'https://teams.microsoft.com/l/meetup-join/19%3ameeting_NzBiNGIwZDgtMjRhNi00MDI5LTg1YjctNDkxMGZiYWM0OGRi%40thread.v2/0?context=%7b%22Tid%22%3a%225870ff96-e2fc-4628-9f0a-9f5e80294a62%22%2c%22Oid%22%3a%224c8f8dc4-0f92-4ee4-90b4-fd87c473d6c9%22%7d' function SheetQR({ value, label }: { value: string; label: string }) { const [src, setSrc] = useState('') useEffect(() => { let alive = true setSrc('') if (value) void QRCode.toDataURL(value, { width: 240, margin: 2, errorCorrectionLevel: 'M' }) .then(uri => { if (alive) setSrc(uri) }) .catch(() => { if (alive) setSrc('') }) return () => { alive = false } }, [value]) return

* Subscribe for updates from some external system, calling setState in a callback function when external state changes.

Calling setState synchronously within an effect body causes cascading renders that can hurt performance, and is not recommended. (https://react.dev/learn/you-might-not-need-an-effect).
